edges.reason: addTokensToStake authorizes staking using msg.sender against the ownerOf check and the game-contract exemption.
claimFromStake selects stakes and the mint beneficiary directly from msg.sender, which is also used as the random seed inside the loop.
_claimFromMiner indexes honestMferStake using msg.sender and validates stake.owner == msg.sender.
_claimFromThief indexes thiefStake using msg.sender and validates stake.owner == msg.sender.
rescue iterates stakes and transfers NFTs to msg.sender after checking stake ownership.
randomThiefOwner is unrestricted and its entropy includes msg.sender via getSomeRandomNumber.
Caller address is packed into the keccak256 pseudo-random seed, making it manipulable.
onERC721Received only accepts transfers whose from address is the zero address.
Stake value is written as block.timestamp, making stake valuation timestamp dependent.
Reward computation, the 2 day lock check and stake resets all rely on block.timestamp.
The _updateEarnings modifier accrues rewards using block.timestamp deltas against totalHonestMferStaked.
totalCoinEarned is incremented by a formula driven purely by block.timestamp and stake totals.
Token ids divisible by 10 are routed to _stakeThiefs.
Non-thief token ids are routed to _stakeHonestMfers.
addTokensToStake pulls the NFT from the caller through mferGame.transferFrom before registering the stake.
Claims for non-thief ids dispatch to _claimFromMiner.
Claims for thief ids dispatch to _claimFromThief.
After the loop over unbounded tokenIds the contract mints COIN to msg.sender via an external call.
The unstake branch draws a pseudo-random number to decide whether the reward is taxed away.
Tax is either fully paid on unstake or on 20% of the owed reward before resetting the stake.
The honest NFT is pushed back to msg.sender with safeTransferFrom, an external callable receiver hook.
totalHonestMferStaked is decremented during an honest unstake.
_claimFromMiner swap-and-pops the honestMferStake array and resets the stake timestamp.
Thief unstake triggers removal of the caller from the thief holder list.
The thief NFT is returned to msg.sender via an external safeTransferFrom call.
rescue performs repeated outbound safeTransferFrom calls inside a loop.
The thief branch of rescue updates the holder address list.
thiefReward is increased by (amount + unaccountedRewards)/totalThiefStaked.
unaccountedRewards accumulates tax when no thief is staked and is zeroed after distribution.
randomThiefOwner derives the holder index from getSomeRandomNumber.
randomThiefOwner advances the randomness index after drawing a number.
shuffleSeeds derives the shuffle count from getSomeRandomNumber.
shuffleSeeds repeatedly calls updateRandomIndex to move the entropy cursor.
Randomness reads balances of the _randomSource addresses selected by _randomIndex.
_randomIndex selects the entropy source and is packed into the random hash.
_randomCalls is packed into the keccak256 randomness seed.
_randomIndex is incremented and wrapped modulo 7.
_randomCalls is incremented on every index update.
onlyOwner can point mferGame at an arbitrary NFT contract.
onlyOwner can point coin at an arbitrary token contract that receives mint rights.
onlyOwner toggles rescueEnabled, unlocking checkless unstaking.
onlyOwner toggles _paused, gating staking and claiming.
onlyOwner overwrites entries of the entropy source table used by the RNG.
totalHonestMferStaked is incremented on each honest stake.
A new honest Stake struct is pushed with the current timestamp as value.
honestMferIndices is written with the new array index.
totalThiefStaked is incremented on each thief stake.
A new thief Stake struct is pushed with thiefReward as value.
New thief holders are appended to the thiefHolders tracker array.
Minted COIN is credited to the caller-controlled msg.sender address.
safeTransferFrom invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient, allowing reentry into claim logic.
Thief unstake safeTransferFrom can call back into the receiver hook before the call returns.
rescue safeTransferFrom can reenter onERC721Received and the rescue/claim paths.
The external coin.mint call to an owner-set contract can reenter claimFromStake.
The untrusted NFT transferFrom during staking can reenter addTokensToStake.
account parameter receives the staked tokens.
tokenIds calldata drives the staking loop.
tokenId parameter selects the honest stake to claim.
unstake parameter chooses the unstake or re-stake branch.
_amount parameter is divided among thief stakes.
_seed parameter is hashed into the random value.
_limit parameter is the modulus applied to the random value.
The accumulated owed amount becomes the argument of the external coin.mint call.
The memory Stake copy supplies owner and value for reward and lock checks.
lastStake is moved into the removed slot during the swap-and-pop array update.
The summed external balances are mixed into the random hash.
The derived hash is truncated to uint16 modulo _limit.
The _state parameter sets the contract pause flag.
The _enabled parameter sets the rescue flag.
The supplied address replaces the mferGame contract reference.
The supplied address replaces the coin contract reference.
account parameter is located in the holder array and swapped out.
tokenIds calldata drives the rescue unstake loop.
_id selects which entropy source slot the owner overwrites.
_address is stored as the new entropy source, affecting the RNG.
_seed parameter drives the shuffle count derivation.
_max parameter bounds the shuffle count.
The from parameter is required to be the zero address for direct receipt.

Branch flag belonging exclusively to _claimFromMiner.
Tax amount is consumed directly by the _payTax distributor.
Seed is used only inside the randomness helper.
Modulus belongs only to the randomness helper.
The owed accumulator directly becomes the amount minted to the caller.
Memory copy used solely within the honest claim routine.
Swap-and-pop helper value local to the honest claim routine.
Entropy accumulator local to the randomness helper.
Hash result local to the randomness helper.
Owner-supplied pause value used only by setPaused.
Owner-supplied rescue value used only by setRescueEnabled.
Address argument assigned to the mferGame state variable.
Address argument assigned to the coin state variable.
Holder address consumed only by the swap-and-pop list update.
Calldata array drives only the rescue loop.
Slot index used only by the owner-only random source setter.
New source address used only by the owner-only random source setter.
Seed used only to derive the shuffle count.
Bound used only to derive the shuffle count.
Origin address checked only inside the receiver callback.
